title: M4 — Lightroom-style crop module
objective: Deliver a crop/straighten module with familiar direct manipulation, semantic controls, live API parity and durable non-destructive history.
context_summary: Starts from the working M3 module host and existing saved recipes. The crop workflow follows docs/specs/single-image.md and the recorded interaction research; proprietary Adobe algorithm equivalence is not claimed.

context_links.label: roadmap
context_links.relevance: Defines this task's behavior, scope and observable acceptance.

acceptance_criteria: Use the working module-based editor as the named baseline and the recorded Lightroom crop research as an interaction reference.
Define stage-relative crop/straighten parameters, inverse mapping, valid source coverage, output rounding and linear-light sampling/filter tolerances.
Specify free/locked ratios, fixed-center proportional Option scaling, crop/pan distinction, guide/numeric straightening, Apply/Cancel and existing rotate/reflection composition.
Golden cases prove no uncovered corners, stable centers where feasible and no cumulative trim when angle gestures return to their starting snapshot.

steps: Work through off-center, near-boundary, portrait/landscape and ±45-degree cases with explicit expected geometry.
Verify mixed pixel/transform/crop order and document independent reference methods; do not claim proprietary algorithm equivalence.
expected_results: Golden cases prove no uncovered corners, stable centers where feasible and no cumulative trim when angle gestures return to their starting snapshot.

acceptance_criteria: Provide module descriptors for Free/Original/1:1/3:2/4:3/16:9/custom ratios, ratio lock/swap, angle, straighten guide, Apply/Cancel and reset.
Implement free side/corner handles, moving composition within the crop frame, thirds overlay and Option/Alt common-factor scaling about the fixed center.
Support Space-drag pan, Fit, numeric zoom and actual source detail at 100%; map handles correctly through logical/physical pixel scaling.
Every gesture translates to semantic module commands and draft state; keyboard and direct API use reproduce the same crop.

steps: Exercise every edge/corner with free/locked ratios and Option at several zoom/DPI scales.
Inspect real native layout/focus and compare pointer-produced parameters against direct API requests.
expected_results: Every gesture translates to semantic module commands and draft state; keyboard and direct API use reproduce the same crop.

acceptance_criteria: Apply commits one layer addition/update and one semantic history entry; Cancel, browsing and pointer motion commit none.
Preserve committed history and layer identities through reset, preview, restore, undo/redo and reopen.
An external commit preserves a human draft and marks conflict; only explicit discard or reapply against the latest revision resolves it.
Historical previews remain immutable, Return to current shows latest state, and stale requests cannot overwrite a saved crop.

steps: Run draft→agent edit→discard/reapply, restore while drafting, failed save and retry cases.
Compare UI/API parameters, snapshot IDs, pixels and saved history before/after restart.
expected_results: Historical previews remain immutable, Return to current shows latest state, and stale requests cannot overwrite a saved crop.
